title: The Coverage Pool of a ShieldCare Plan
content:
Cover on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is held as a pool. The plan's term coverage
limit is credited once when the coverage window opens, and every payout is taken from that
credited pool, so the cover remaining on the plan is the credited cover less the payouts
booked against it.

Cover is credited only to a plan standing as an application received, active, or held while a
claim is under review. The plan record is the authority for that standing and it is settled
before the credit is written.

On the plans that reinstate, the full term limit is credited again at each coverage anniversary
and the unused remainder of the previous year is not carried forward. On the plans that do not
reinstate, the term limit is credited once for the whole term. A reinstatement is booked once
per coverage year, and a plan that expires, is cancelled or is terminated before an anniversary
is not reinstated for that year.

Cover is never credited above the plan's term limit by way of a correction. An over-payment is
put right by reversing the payout that caused it.

### The pool restated as a running figure

| Entry on the plan | Effect on the cover remaining |
| --- | --- |
| the term limit credited when the window opens | raises the cover remaining by the term limit |
| the term limit credited again at an anniversary, on a plan that reinstates | raises the cover remaining by the term limit; the unused remainder of the year just ended is not carried forward |
| a payout booked on a claim | lowers the cover remaining by the amount paid |
| an over-payment found after the event | put right by reversing the payout, never by crediting cover afresh |

### A worked case on hypothetical figures

A plan with a term limit of 2000.00 that does not reinstate has 2000.00 credited when its
window opens. Two payouts of 500.00 and 300.00 are booked. The cover remaining is 1200.00.
Were the same plan one that reinstates, the anniversary would credit 2000.00 again and the
cover remaining would stand at 2000.00 from that day, the 1200.00 left from the year just
ended being neither added to it nor kept.
